en.headline: Paul Chan expects over 100 mega events in second half to draw 1.85 million visitors
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said first-half events already attracted 1.75 million participants and generated about HK$5.8 billion in spending, with retail sales rising for 14 consecutive months.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog on Sunday that Hong Kong plans to host more than 100 mega events in the second half of 2026, expected to attract over 1.85 million visitors and generate about HK$5.9 billion in spending with an economic value-added of roughly HK$3.3 billion.

Looking back at the first half, Chan said around 1.75 million people took part in more than 130 events, contributing about HK$5.8 billion in consumption and HK$3.3 billion in value-added. He noted that retail sales value had risen for 14 consecutive months, with a 9.6 per cent increase in the first half of the year.

Recent football matches at the Kai Tak Sports Park drew more than 120,000 spectators and ticket revenue estimated above HK$180 million, while nearby restaurants reported business growth of about 20 per cent. Upcoming events include the HKTDC Food Expo, National Day fireworks, the Hong Kong Cyclothon and the Wine & Dine Festival. Chan added that Hong Kong will host the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting in October, offering a platform to showcase the city as both an international financial centre and a vibrant events destination.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：下半年逾100項盛事料吸185萬旅客
zh.dek: 財政司司長在網誌表示，上半年盛事已吸引175萬人次參與並帶來約58億元消費，零售業總銷貨價值連升14個月。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波周日在網誌表示，香港下半年將舉辦超過100項盛事活動，預計吸引逾185萬旅客參與，帶來約59億元消費額，經濟增加價值約33億元。
他指上半年約有175萬人次參與逾130項盛事，帶來約58億元消費及33億元經濟增加價值。零售業總銷貨價值已連升14個月，上半年升幅為9.6%。
近期啟德體育園舉行的足球賽事吸引逾12萬觀眾入場，門票收入預計超過1.8億元，附近食肆生意增長約兩成。下半年活動包括貿發局美食博覽、國慶煙花匯演、香港單車節及香港美酒佳餚巡禮等。陳茂波又提到，香港將於10月首次承辦亞太經合組織財政部長會議，屆時可展示香港作為國際金融中心及盛事之都的優勢。
